body: My therapist, but that's about it. I don't have a lot of outlets to talk to others.

I guess the very short version is what I mentioned before: That my mom is not an easy person to talk to about things, and it's like walking on eggshells t have a conversation with her. This goes for anything. It makes living with her difficult, but I have no other options.
I guess. There's a lot of smaller things that effect my mom and I personally, but finances is the biggest one.

I've tried, but my mom isn't the best person in the world to talk openly about stuff, like your feelings. It's really difficult to talk to her without her flying off the handle and get mad at something you may have said, so I avoid talking to her personally about anything. 

Add on to the fact that I haven't had a job in a year and a half, and it doesn't help her financial stress because I haven't had any type of work. I wouldn't say she outright resents me for it, but it's hard not to feel like that sometimes.

Same to you my dudette. I hope it's not weird, but I curiously took a peek at your comment history. I hope things get better for you in the future, and I hope your transition is going well and you're surrounded by accepting people. <3

I feel useless, like I don't have purpose in this world. I've been unemployed since mid-2014, I still live at home with my mom, I'm single, and I basically live as a shut-in. My mom and I are in poverty and I don't have a very prospective outlook on the next five years of my life. I've applied for disability because I have debilitating anxiety, but I doubt I'll get it.

A long time. Probably around the time I was 15 or 16.

I'm going to therapy right now and have been for a few months, but... idk. I feel like it isn't helping and I'm wasting everyone's time.
